owe: be obliged to pay or repay

owen: Welsh industrialist and social reformer who founded cooperative communities (1771-1858)

owlclaws: stout perennial herb of western United States having flower heads with drooping orange-yellow rays
owlishly: the gentle-looking barrister peered owlishly around him

own: He owns three houses in Florida

belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself)
own goal: (soccer) a goal that results when a player inadvertently knocks the ball into the goal he is defending

own right: by title vested in yourself or by virtue of qualifications that you have achieved
a peer in his own right
a leading sports figure in his own right
a fine opera in its own right
own up: admit or acknowledge a wrongdoing or error
owner: (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business

owner-driver: a motorist who owns the car that he/she drives
owner-occupied: one owner-occupied and three rental apartments
owner-occupier: an occupant who owns the home that he/she lives in
ownership: the relation of an owner to the thing possessed
the act of having and controlling property
the state or fact of being an owner
